items.author: sizeablecat.bsky.social
items.context:
It's good to see games like this have a deeper impact. Cuety/relaxing games like this can hit so far outside of the 'normal' gaming community.
quotes @alexgorlando.bsky.social: Not the top Steam review of Dressmaker making me cry this morning!
items.text: Agreed, gentle games often reach people who don't usually play anything. The quiet ones tend to stick with you.

items.author: 1001cranes.bsky.social
items.context: i love a cozy, simple, linear, un-failable little ~3 hour nugget of a game. i will play this next to a (fake) fireplace with some cocoa, and I am genuinely looking forward to that.
items.text: A short, can't-fail game by a (fake) fireplace with cocoa sounds like the perfect evening. Hope it's as good as you're expecting.

items.author: nihilnihilnihil.bsky.social
items.context: Mysteries Under Lake Ophelia and Creature Kitchen are both examples of games that are both incredibly relaxing but have a slight horror edge. Anyone know of any others?
items.text: Dredge is the one that comes to mind: calm fishing by day, a little uneasy once night falls.

items.author: m-vixn.bsky.social
items.context: dude I need more cozy horror/cozy creepy games like Dredge and Creature Kitchen 😭
items.text: Strange Horticulture has a spooky occult mood but it's a calm plant-shop puzzle game, and Cozy Grove is gentle and a bit eerie too. Neither is really scary.
